replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
1. First of all if 199ms makes you take that little KB, then I should never take KB with my 280-350ms and Posighdun should be an anti KB god with his 1000ms.

2. I'm not saying you take zero KB, I'm saying that you don't take enough KB, hence why I banned you for "Reduced Knockback" 

3. I'm glad that you got a combo on a lagging person, yet I'm struggling to see how that is significant in this appeal.

4. I put this up earlier in your appeal and I still stand by it:

"And in the following clips you show signs of bunnyhopping and extremely unnatural movement, common traits of a horizontal knockback reducer. This type of movement can’t be blamed on lag either, judging by your ludicrous range/hit detection/APS:
https://youtu.be/thJMWb_-eTs?t=37s
https://youtu.be/rZj3vfjPyfg?t=8s (https://youtu.be/rZj3vfjPyfg?t=3s)"

You can't be taking the KB of someone with bad connection yet get the hits of someone with good connection.

5. So either you do have really bad connection so you don't take as much knockback and you're using an Autoclicker/Reach/Aim assist to hit people or you have good connection in which case your hits are fine and accounted for but your knockback is being reduced.

6. You had 5 bars when I was watching you as oppose to someone like me who consistently gets 3 bars yet I take at least quadruple the amount of knockback you take and can hit from about half your distance....

So in conclusion you're going to need to explain all instances in the video I provided with a better excuse than "I combo'd a laggy person"  and in that part of the video, you took basically no horizontal knockback on his final hit.
